ingest.note: Lightweight frame-based VAD using the WebRTC voice activity detector. Fastest but least accurate.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: WebRTC VAD classifies each audio frame as speech or non-speech using GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model). On consecutive speech frames during agent output, triggers interruption.
interruption.code_hint: Install py-webrtcvad. Configure aggressiveness 0-3 (3 = most aggressive). Pipecat: WebRTCVADAnalyzer. LiveKit: use a custom VAD adapter.

potholes.note: WebRTC VAD has lower accuracy than Silero, especially in noisy environments. May cause false interruptions or miss quiet speech.
Pure C library with no model to download. Lowest cold-start latency — ideal for serverless deployments.
